name: io.github.cyanheads/gbif-biodiversity-mcp-server
description: Search GBIF species taxonomy, occurrence records, datasets, and publishers.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_LOG_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: Sets the minimum log level for output (e.g., 'debug', 'info', 'warn').

environmentVariables.name: GBIF_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL every GBIF API request is built from. Override to route through a proxy or a mirror of the GBIF v1 API.

environmentVariables.name: GBIF_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS
environmentVariables.description: Milliseconds a single GBIF API request may take before it is aborted. Aborted attempts fall to the service's retry policy.

environmentVariables.name: GBIF_USER_AGENT
environmentVariables.description: Sent as the User-Agent header on every GBIF API request. GBIF asks integrators to identify themselves with a contact URL or email. Unset or blank sends the server name, version, and repository URL.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_HTTP_HOST
environmentVariables.description: The hostname for the HTTP server.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_HTTP_PORT
environmentVariables.description: The port to run the HTTP server on.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_HTTP_ENDPOINT_PATH
environmentVariables.description: The endpoint path for the MCP server.
